CommunityApplications.Profile: WeComHub is an Unraid WeCom (WeChat Work) hub plugin maintained by deltrivx. It forwards Unraid system notifications to WeCom through a self-hosted relay, and accepts WeCom commands to run whitelisted read-only queries or restart allowed containers. All settings are configured from Settings - Notification. The repository contains the plugin, release snapshots, documentation, security notes, and support information.
